# Embedded constructs

Ordinary paragraph for the edit-isolation check.

<!-- comments remain source bytes -->

<section data-transport="html-block">
  <strong>Raw HTML stays raw.</strong>
</section>

<details>
<summary>More context</summary>

The details body is Markdown.

</details>

Inline math stays opaque: $E = mc^2$ and $\sum_{i=1}^{n} i$.
